n: Sika Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell

d.s: Sika Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell is manufactured from closed cell, low density, polyethylene foam. Sika Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell has excellent compression and recovery properties, is available in various sizes and lengths. The round profile assists in providing the correct joint sealant profile allowing optimum movement capability.
a: Provides a bond breaker, avoids three sided adhesion
Compatible with cold applied sealants (polyurethane, silicone)
us: Sika Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell is used as a backing rod for horiontal and vertical expansion joints placed prior to the application of sealants. Sika Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell provides bond breaking, assists in the control of joint depths for correct joint design, allows for proper sealant tooling, improves contact with joint flanks and reducing sealant consumption.

sec.t: Low density polyethylene closed cell foam
60 months from the date of production
